profile.excerpt: Mr. Prithvi Vachani is currently serving as the Vice President at Dixon Technologies (India) Limited. A 2017 graduate of Bentley University, Mr. Prithvi quickly demonstrated his strategic acumen upon entering the professional arena. His exceptional foresight and leadership were notably displayed when he successfully orchestrated a major collaboration with boAt, India's leading audio product company, resulting in the production of innovative twin wireless speakers.
